{{Quote|Nik, none of you should be living here. We can't guarantee your safety, you know that.|Officer Mal, to Nik Deleru, about refugees in the Old Galactic Market|<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />}}
'''Mal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] Mal was assigned to the [[Old Galactic Market]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, Mal tried to fulfill his duty of keeping the peace; however, he was hampered by a lack of resources and the fighting between CSF [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] forces and [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] thugs. On one occasion, Mal was approached by a refugee [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] named [[Nik Deleru]] whose mate, [[Ria Deleru]], had been taken by the Guild. Though Mal was unable to assist, an individual offered to help retrieve Ria.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I failed to pay my protection payments and as you can see, Coruscant Security could care less.''"<br />"''Oh, for goodness sake Nik give it a rest!|Nik Deleru and Officer Mal|<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />}}
[[Officer/Legends|Officer]] Mal was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mal was assigned to the [[Old Galactic Market]] commercial district of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. In the aftermath of some [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|riots]], the Old Galactic Market had been overrun by refugees and a criminal organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]. The Guild claimed to protect the interests of the refugees, but in reality, it demanded protection [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] and was involved in illegal actives such as money laundering and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. Though the CSF had been able to retake a portion of the Galactic Market, most of it remained under the Guild's control.<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] named [[Nik Deleru]] reported to Mal that his mate, [[Ria Deleru]], had been taken by the Guild. Nik requested Mal's help in retrieving her; however, Mal did not have enough men to enter the Guild control area and retrieve Ria.<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
While arguing over the CSF's ability to retrieve Ria from the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters]], a Republic individual offered to retrieve Ria for Nik. The individual was able to locate Ria, who informed them that she had actually intentionally left Nik and wanted to make a better life for herself. She asked that the individual tell Nik that she had left the planet. The individual returned to Nik and Officer Mal and reported what Ria had requested.<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I wish I could help Nik, I really do. But I can't spare the manpower.|Officer Mal, about retrieving Ria Deleru from the Migrant Merchants' Guild|<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />}}
Officer Mal was dark-skinned, with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He was dedicated to his job and felt it was his duty to protect. Faced with the struggles of the refugees, Mal believed that since they had no business living in the Old Galactic Market, any situation in which they became involved was partially of their own doing. The refugees in turn blamed the CSF for not stopping the Guild. Tired of being blamed for their problems by the refugees, Mal nevertheless cared for their plight. Yet with the CSF's lack of manpower and resources, he was unable to get involved and help the refugees with problems involving the Guild. This led Mal to become frustrated with the Guild, the refugees, and his inability to act.<ref name="SWTORforbetwor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mal appears in the "For Better or Worse" Republic-sided mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The player can choose to accept the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] mission from Nik Deleru to rescue Ria. During the conversation, Mal's frustrations and opinions are revealed. For light side points, the player can choose to tell Nik that Ria was gone or can force Ria to return to Nik for dark side points. This article assumes that the character chooses the light side option.
